sloka: ततः समरकोपेन संयुक्तो रावणात्मजः।विभीषणं त्रिभिर्बाणैर्विव्याध वदने शुभे ।। ६.९१.३९ ।।
transliteration: tataḥ samarakopena saṁyukto rāvaṇātmajaḥ।vibhīṣaṇaṁ tribhirbāṇairvivyādha vadane śubhe ।। 6.91.39 ।।

translations.english: Both wishing for victory, set to tear each other, pierced dreadful arrows on one another all over the limbs, opposing.
